overview.title: Overview
overview.placeholder: Revenue, orders and stock appear here once the orders module is in place.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

fields.name: Your name
fields.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong password.

setup.title: Set up the owner account
setup.intro: This page works once: it creates the only account of the owner workspace.
setup.tokenHint: The value of OWNER_SETUP_TOKEN in the container settings.
setup.completed: The owner account is set up.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.intro: Scan the code with an authenticator app, or type the key into it, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qr: QR code for the authenticator app

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.intro: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator app. Keep them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Formline Admin, the back office of the Formline poster store.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.intro: This change needs a fresh sign-in: your password and a code, or a passkey.

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
verify.introRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.
verify.noTotp: This account has no authenticator app. Use a recovery code, or sign in with your passkey.

recover.title: Recover the owner account
recover.intro: Run pnpm owner:recovery where the database can be reached, and enter the code it prints. You set a new password, a new authenticator app and new recovery codes; every passkey and every session of the owner is removed.

errors.unavailable: Setup is not available on this server.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.token_invalid: The setup token is not correct.
errors.password_breached: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
errors.code_invalid: The code is not correct. Check it and try again.
errors.second_factor_locked: Too many wrong codes. Two-step verification is locked for an hour, and the owner has been notified.
errors.recovery_invalid: The recovery code is not valid or has expired.
errors.passkey_failed: The passkey could not be verified. Try again, or sign in with your password.
errors.passkey_unknown: This passkey is not registered here any more.
errors.session_expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
errors.last_factor: This is your only second factor. Add another one before you remove it.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password and a code.
passkeys.removeBody: You can no longer sign in with it, and your other signed-in devices are signed out.
passkeys.sandbox: Passkeys are available in a real account. A passkey made here would stay in your password manager after the demo is deleted.
